title: Oholah and Oholibah: The Fall of Samaria and Jerusalem
description: A powerful allegory in which two sisters, Oholah (Samaria) and Oholibah (Jerusalem), are described as adulterous women who turn to other nations to find satisfaction, leading to a severe judgment from God. The story depicts their sinful alliances with the Assyrians, Babylonians, and Egyptians, and ends with a detailed account of their destruction and exile [ref:Ezek 23:1-49|Ezekiel 23:1-49].
